issues.t: Valve springs can break and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: A ticking or tapping from the engine, rough running, a flashing check engine light, or the engine stalling while you drive.
issues.why: Some 2013 cars got valve springs that can crack. A broken spring lets a valve misbehave, which can make the engine run badly or quit.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. The dealer replaces the valve springs for free. If the engine stalls or knocks, stop and have it towed.

issues.t: Engine knock or failure after the valve spring recall repair
issues.sym: Knocking, vibration, loss of power or a seized engine, often some time after the valve spring recall was done.
issues.why: The recall job means taking the top of the engine apart. Dozens of owners told NHTSA their engines knocked or failed afterward, and some were refused help by the dealer or Subaru.
issues.next: If knocking starts after the recall, stop driving and go back to the dealer that did the work. Keep the repair order, and contact Subaru of America in writing if you are refused.

issues.t: Engine knock, stalling or sudden engine failure
issues.sym: A rattle or knock from the engine, stalling at idle or at a light, a flashing check engine light, or the engine seizing.
issues.why: Owners report broken valve springs and rocker arms on cars outside the recall, and engines that seized at higher mileage. Running low on oil makes it worse.
issues.next: Check the oil level often, since these engines can use some. If it knocks or the check engine light flashes, stop driving and have it towed for diagnosis.

issues.t: Rough idle or stalling with cam timing codes
issues.sym: The idle speed hunts up and down, the car shudders or stalls as you stop, and the check engine light shows cam timing codes (P0016 to P0019).
issues.why: The engine's variable valve timing (AVCS) parts on early cars were built to loose tolerances, and a faulty cam sprocket can also cause it. Subaru released new software and parts through service bulletins.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask the dealer about the AVCS service bulletins. A software update or a new cam sprocket or oil control valve usually fixes it.

issues.t: Manual transmission noise, grinding or hard shifting
issues.sym: Rattling or metal-on-metal noise from the gearbox, grinding when shifting, or gears that are hard to get into.
issues.why: Owners of manual cars report gearbox faults, some at very low mileage, and some needing a whole new transmission. TrueDelta owners also report transmission replacements.
issues.next: Have it checked while still under warranty if you can. Make sure the gear oil is the correct type and level.

issues.t: Clutch release bearing noise or clutch failure
issues.sym: A chirp, whine or grinding noise that changes when you press the clutch pedal, a soft pedal, or a burning smell and slipping.
issues.why: The clutch release (throwout) bearing is a known weak spot on these cars, and clutches can wear early with hard driving.
issues.next: Have the clutch inspected if it is noisy or slips. The bearing is usually replaced along with the clutch, since the gearbox has to come out for either.

issues.t: Chirping or cricket noise from the fuel pump
issues.sym: A chirp or cricket-like ticking from the engine bay, often more noticeable when the engine is warm.
issues.why: The high-pressure fuel pump for the direct injection makes this noise. Subaru issued a service bulletin about it, and many owners report it.
issues.next: It is usually harmless. Ask the dealer about the high-pressure fuel pump bulletin if the noise bothers you.

issues.t: In-tank fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine may run rough, lose power, or stall while driving and not restart.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump inside the tank can fail, cutting fuel to the engine. It is part of a big recall on many Subaru and Toyota models.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. The dealer replaces the pump for free.

issues.t: Oil leaks onto the exhaust
issues.sym: A burning-oil smell while driving, oily spots under the car, or light smoke from the engine bay.
issues.why: Oil can seep from engine seals and covers and drip onto the hot exhaust. Subaru has a service bulletin on finding and fixing oil seepage on these engines.
issues.next: Have the leak found and fixed soon, since oil on the exhaust is a fire risk. Ask the dealer about the oil seepage bulletin.

issues.t: Water or condensation in the tail lights
issues.sym: Fog or water droplets inside the tail lights, sometimes enough to dim the brake lights.
issues.why: The tail light housings can let water in. It is the most common problem in TrueDelta's owner survey.
issues.next: Have the lights replaced under warranty if possible. Make sure the brake lights work, since water can short them.

issues.t: Rearview mirror shakes or falls off
issues.sym: The inside mirror vibrates so you can't see clearly, or the mount breaks and the mirror drops off the windshield.
issues.why: The mirror mount, especially on cars with the heavier HomeLink mirror, can come loose from the glass.
issues.next: Have the mount re-glued or replaced. Don't drive without a working mirror.

issues.t: Power window switch stops working
issues.sym: A window won't go up or down, or works only some of the time.
issues.why: The window switches wear out. Window seals and regulators also show up in owner surveys.
issues.next: Try the window from the other switch to narrow it down, then replace the faulty switch or regulator.

issues.t: Fuel pump clicks off early when filling up
issues.sym: The gas station nozzle keeps shutting off almost right away, making the tank hard to fill.
issues.why: An owner reports the filler hose may collapse or the tank vent may not breathe well, so the nozzle senses a full tank too soon.
issues.next: Try filling slowly with the nozzle at a different angle. If it keeps happening, have the filler neck and EVAP vent checked.

issues.t: Airbag light on or passenger airbag turns off
issues.sym: The airbag warning light comes on now and then, or the passenger airbag "off" light shows with an adult in the seat.
issues.why: Owners report faults with the passenger seat sensor system that decides whether the passenger airbag should be on.
issues.next: Have the airbag system scanned soon. Don't let an adult ride in front if the passenger airbag says off.

issues.t: Radio screen fails and backup camera stops working
issues.sym: The head unit freezes or stops working, taking Bluetooth calling and the backup camera with it.
issues.why: An owner reports the head unit failed after a software update. Subaru issued several reprogramming bulletins for this audio unit.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to reflash or replace the head unit under any warranty that applies.

issues.t: Engine failure from sealant clogging the oil pickup
issues.sym: Low oil pressure warning, knocking, or sudden engine failure, often at low mileage.
issues.why: Too much silicone sealant was used on the oil pan at the factory. Bits of it can break off and block the oil pickup screen, starving the engine of oil.
issues.next: If you have a 2022, ask a shop or dealer to drop the oil pan and check the pickup screen. Stop right away if the oil light comes on.

issues.t: Rear turn signals stop working in bright sun (recall)
issues.sym: The turn signals flash fast, and the rear signals may not light when the sun is behind the car.
issues.why: A fault in the rear combination lamps can make the turn signals stop working off and on.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. The dealer replaces both rear lamps for free.

issues.t: Fuel leak at the injectors or fuel rail
issues.sym: A fuel smell, rough running, or a stall when a cylinder floods with fuel.
issues.why: An owner reports leaking injector O-rings. Subaru also raised the tightening spec for the fuel rail mounting bolts in a 2023 service bulletin.
issues.next: If you smell fuel, stop driving it. Ask the dealer to check the injector seals and fuel rail bolts against the bulletin.

issues.t: Fuel lines rub against the hood
issues.sym: Usually nothing you notice until damage is done. Look for worn or shiny spots on the fuel line covers near the driver-side hood.
issues.why: Owners report the fuel lines on the driver's side can rub on the underside of the hood. An owner says this has led to engine fires on these cars.
issues.next: Open the hood and look at the fuel line covers near the driver side. Ask the dealer to inspect and protect them.

issues.t: High oil use with no low-oil warning
issues.sym: Oil level drops several quarts between changes and the car gives no warning. Some engines start knocking.
issues.why: Owners report the 2.4L using a lot of oil, and one engine was replaced twice under warranty. The car has no oil level warning, only a pressure light that comes on too late.
issues.next: Check the dipstick every few fill-ups. If it uses more than a quart every few thousand miles, start an oil consumption test with the dealer.

issues.t: Check engine light for timing correlation codes
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with codes P0016, P0017 or P0018. The car may feel normal or idle a little rough.
issues.why: These codes mean the engine computer sees the camshaft and crankshaft out of step. Subaru issued a service bulletin with new engine computer software for these codes.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Ask the dealer about the engine computer reprogramming bulletin before replacing any parts.

issues.t: Check engine light for an engine computer fault
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P0606, which points to the engine computer itself.
issues.why: Subaru released new engine computer software to correct this code on these cars.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check for the reprogramming bulletin. It is usually a software fix, not a new computer.

issues.t: Remote app features stop working after about a year
issues.sym: Remote start, lock and other STARLINK app features stop working, roughly a year after you activated them.
issues.why: A timer in the telematics module was set wrong and shuts off remote services after 388 days. Subaru issued a campaign to fix it.
issues.next: Contact the dealer. The telematics module gets a free update.
